MRI Safety Information
The Aster Infusion Pump is MR Conditional. A person with the Aster Infusion Pump may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Aster Infusion Pump
Device Configuration MRI SureScan mode
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T or 3.0 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 2000 Gauss/cm
RF Transmit Coil Type Body transmit coil or head transmit coil
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions B1+rms <= 1 uT
Scan Regions Extremity scanning only (knee and below, elbow and below)
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 3 mm from the device.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
